description: Use this when the user asks LivinIsto to keep watching Czech property listings (flats, houses, cottages, building plots; sale or rent) for them over time (e.g. "let me know until March about a 2+kk flat in Brno under 5 million CZK"). This does NOT start watching by itself and takes no e-mail address or other personal data: it returns a consentUrl on www.livinisto.cz that the user must open themselves, enter their own e-mail there and confirm by clicking the link LivinIsto e-mails them. Never ask the user for their e-mail in the conversation and never open the link for them. An unconfirmed draft is deleted after 24 hours. Matching homes are e-mailed to the user and can also be read with intent_list_matches using the returned intentCode — keep it in the conversation. hiddenLimitCzk is optional: the most the user would pay in CZK (monthly for rent), stored encrypted and never shown to sellers or returned by any tool; pass it only if the user said it. Matches come from listings LivinIsto aggregates from the Czech market (its own listings and public listings from Czech property portals), so they cover only homes listed on LivinIsto (Czech Republic, prices in CZK) and may be incomplete; no commercial property and nothing abroad.

buyBy.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the user wants to buy or rent; watching stops after it.

hiddenLimitCzk.description: Optional private maximum price in CZK (monthly for rent); encrypted on receipt and never returned by any tool.

lang.description: Optional language of the replies (texts only; codes, URLs and statuses never change). By default the language of the statement.

niceToHave.description: Wishes that are not required (never filters), e.g. "balkon, výtah".

statement.description: What the home MUST be, as one short Czech phrase, e.g. "byt 2+kk Brno do 5 milionů" or "pronájem 1+kk Praha do 18000".

name: intent_publish_intent

consentExpiresAt.description: ISO time after which the unconfirmed draft is deleted.

consentUrl.description: Page on www.livinisto.cz where the USER confirms the intent with their own e-mail. Show it unchanged.

hasHiddenLimit.description: Whether a hidden limit was stored. Its value is never returned.

intentCode.description: Secret code of this intent; use it with intent_get_intent, intent_list_matches and intent_withdraw_intent.

notUnderstood.description: Words of the statement that are NOT watched for as a filter. Tell the person.

status.description: awaiting_consent = the user has not confirmed on the LivinIsto page yet; awaiting_email_confirmation = the user filled in the page and must click the link in the e-mail; active = LivinIsto is watching; expired = the confirmation link, the buy-by date or the intent's validity ran out; withdrawn = cancelled.

understood.description: What LivinIsto will watch for, read from the statement (in Czech). Tell the person before they confirm.

title: Watch new Czech property listings for the user (needs the user's confirmation)
